initial.presence: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production 2D fighting-game sprite atlas. Input images are CHARACTER AND STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets. Preserve the exact original Bushman: a lean muscular bark-covered humanoid wildfire creature, angular wood-plated eyeless-looking pointed face, long sweeping mane of burning twig/leaf strands trailing behind the head, dark charred brown wood armor and roots, glowing orange fissures and flames attached to hair, forearms and shins, claw hands and root-like claw feet, small bark/leaf hip frill. No clothes, weapons, human hair, human face or new armor. Detailed inked/shaded comic style matching the references. He faces SCREEN LEFT in every full-body pose, three-quarter side combat angle. Keep identical body proportions, source anatomical sides and fixed camera. ONE transparent PNG sheet with EXACTLY sixteen isolated complete bodies, four columns by four rows of equal cells, preferably 2048x2048. At least 25 pixels of transparent margin on all sides of each figure, including the burning mane, hands and feet. True alpha-0 background: no brown backdrop, no orange haze, no floor, no shadow, no text, no grid, no detached embers or particles. Flames attached directly to his existing body are allowed; all other space must be transparent. This is the PRESENCE / REACTION sheet. Row-major poses 0-7 are consecutive keys of ONE coherent eight-step walking cycle toward SCREEN LEFT. 0 near foot forward contact and far foot behind; 1 weight settles onto near foot; 2 far foot passes the planted near leg; 3 far foot swings forward while near heel lifts; 4 far foot forward contact and near foot behind; 5 weight settles onto far foot; 6 near foot passes the planted far leg; 7 near foot swings forward toward pose 0. Both legs must alternate and both arms counter-swing, with the flame mane following subtly. Do not repeat one-sided steps. Poses 8-11 are four quiet breathing/guard stances, both feet planted at matching ground level, subtle chest/shoulder and mane changes. Pose 12 light punch recoil, chest/head tipping backward toward SCREEN RIGHT; pose 13 heavy kick recoil with torso braced backward toward SCREEN RIGHT; pose 14 low stagger with one foot catching balance; pose 15 recovery back into guard. All bodies complete and separated; no knee-down defeat pose on this sheet.

reaction_detail: Use case: illustration-story. Character reference: the supplied Bushman atlas. Create a NEW transparent sprite sheet, 4 columns by 2 rows, exactly EIGHT complete full-body figures. Use exactly this lean charcoal-brown bark humanoid with a sweeping orange flame mane, orange fissures, wooden claws and root feet. Preserve left-facing three-quarter view, same mane and head, same proportions and detailed comic illustration. All bodies fully isolated, generous transparent margins including flame tips and feet. NO colored background, haze, glow outside the body, shadows, particles, grid or words. Top row is the OPPOSITE HALF of a leftward WALK from the reference: in the first and second cells the NEAR leg (the visibly foreground leg) extends diagonally BACKWARD toward SCREEN RIGHT, with the near root foot BEHIND THE HIP on the RIGHT; the FAR leg reaches diagonally FORWARD toward SCREEN LEFT, with far root foot planted ahead on the LEFT. This leg exchange is essential: DO NOT repeat the reference's near-leg-forward stance. Top cell 0: FAR foot forward left contact, NEAR foot back right. Top cell 1: weight over FAR foot on left; NEAR heel raises behind to the right. Top cell 2: NEAR knee/foot passes directly beneath the hip, FAR foot remains forward left on ground. Top cell 3: NEAR knee now swings forward left, FAR heel lifts. Keep upper body left-facing; near arm counter-swings forward when near leg trails backward. Bottom row: cell 4 light hit recoil, head/chest tipped slightly backward toward SCREEN RIGHT, two feet planted; cell 5 HEAVY hit recoil, chest leaning well back toward SCREEN RIGHT, knees bent to brace, BOTH FEET FIRMLY ON THE GROUND and no kick, no raised foot; cell 6 low stagger, knees flexed, both feet on ground, head still facing LEFT; cell 7 recovered upright guard with two feet planted. No combat kicks anywhere. Eight anatomically coherent distinct poses, all flame hair and feet fully within cells.
final_walk: Use case: illustration-story. Reference image is for the character design ONLY, not its pose. Create four NEW full-body animation drawings of this exact Bushman, arranged 2x2 on a transparent background. Same charred bark humanoid, burning orange mane sweeping behind him, glowing cracks, claw hands, root feet, same comic illustration. Every torso and head faces LEFT. This sheet is specifically a WALK half-cycle with the FRONT/VISIBLE LEG TRAILING BEHIND. Draw the big foreground thigh sloping DOWN AND TO THE RIGHT from the hip: its knee is visibly to the RIGHT of his pelvis, and its foot is FAR TO THE RIGHT of his body. The other, background leg extends forward LEFT, its foot FAR LEFT of the body. His near arm reaches slightly LEFT to counterbalance the trailing near leg. This is the opposite leg stance from the portrait; do not copy the portrait's leg pose. TOP LEFT pose: foreground knee right of hip, foreground foot planted far right, background leg fully forward left. TOP RIGHT: same foreground leg trailing right but its heel lifts, weight on background left foot. BOTTOM LEFT: foreground knee returns to be directly BELOW the hip and foot passes underneath, weight still on background leg. BOTTOM RIGHT: foreground knee now swings forward LEFT ready for next contact. Keep the head/torso unchanged and left-facing through all four. Four distinct physically coherent poses, consistent full-body size and same scale. No kick, no facing right, no mirrored torso. Solid character with attached flames only. Alpha-0 background everywhere else, no haze, shadow, glow, grid, text or particles. Keep every flame tip, claw and foot inside each cell with at least 30px clear margins. Prefer square 1536x1536.
